Regulatory headwinds (Supreme Court App Store ruling, EU DMA fines, DOJ suit) targeting Services economics and tariff exposure ($3.3B cumulative) add risk to the premium multiple. Net-net: a high-quality franchise with solid trajectory, but fairly valued to modestly rich at current levels, with limited margin of safety and a near-term catalyst that could go either way.

The score of +0.35 reflects strong fundamentals and cheap valuation partially offset by the leverage-induced balance-sheet risk and segment-specific headwinds. The near-term catalyst is the Q1 earnings beat and raised FY27 guidance ($45.9-46.2B), but the soft Q2 guide and RPO miss ($67.9B vs $68.9B consensus) temper the re-rating probability.
